Assessment: Severe oral cavity inflammation likely secondary to mandibular fracture. Pain and reduced appetite are consistent with the injury and inflammation.
Plan: Provide pain management and anti-inflammatory treatment. Recommend soft diet to accommodate jaw fracture. Schedule follow-up for fracture healing assessment and possible surgical intervention. Monitor for signs of infection or worsening condition.
